subject: Re: Looking For Customs Bond Support
body:
Hi Kashay,


Thank you for reaching out to BorderBuddy!


We can assist Immunora Bio LLC with securing an annual/continuous U.S. customs bond.


Our fees are as follows:

Annual/Continuous Bond: $640 USD


CBP Importer Registration / Form 5106: $125 USD, if a CBP-assigned importer number is required.


Step 1 - Broker Authorization
Please complete our Power of Attorney (POA) electronic form.


The POA must be completed by an authorized signing officer whose name matches their government-issued ID exactly, including any middle name or initial.


The form will guide you through the required identification and supporting business documentation. I've also attached our Supporting Business Document Guide for reference.
Step 2 - Annual Bond Application
Please complete the Annual Bond Application & Indemnity Form.


Once both forms are submitted, we'll review the information and confirm the next steps.


Thank you!

Warm regards,

subject: Automatic reply: Continuous Bond for Our First Shipment
body:
Thank you for reaching out to us. We have received your inquiry and appreciate your patience.

Due to the increasing number of duty-related inquiries and frequent tariff changes, our response time may be slightly delayed. Please rest assured that we are processing all requests in the order they are received and will respond as soon as possible.

Please note that inquiries involving regulatory interpretation or prospective compliance matters (such as free trade agreements, AD/CVD inquires, labeling, or other compliance determinations) may be best addressed by a qualified trade attorney or customs compliance consultant. We would be happy to assist with entry processing and implementation once formal guidance is available.

We appreciate your understanding and will do our best to assist you promptly.

Best regards,
Assured CHB, Inc.
